title_sq: Shitet apartament 1+1 prane Pallatit me Shigjeta!
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 1+1 prane Shkolles 26 Nentori ne Tirane e re! 
 Ndodhet ne katin e trete te nje pallati ekzistues, te vitit 92.
 Ofron siperfaqe prej 57 m2 qe organizohet ne sallon sebashku me kuzhinen, dhome gjumi, korridor, tualet dhe ballkon.
 Apartamenti eshte restauruar totalisht, 
 sistem hidraulik dhe elektrike i ri, hidrosanitare të reja,
 patinim i ri, dyer dhe dritareje te reja.
 I shtruar me parket.
 Orientimi apartamentit eshte Jug-Lindje -Perendim qe i jep drite natyrale.
 Ndodhet ne nje zone te preferuar si nga vendasit por dhe te huajt me te gjitha sherbimet prane qe e ben te favorshme si per banim dhe per investim.
 Ka akses te shpejte me Autostraden Tirane-Elbasan, zonen e Komunes Parisit, Bulevardin Bajram Curri, rrugen e Kavajes.
 Prona disponon certifikate te rregullt pronesie .
 Cmimi 118.000 euro.
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale near Palace of Arrows!
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale near the 26th of November School in new Tirana! It is located on the third floor of an existing building, built in 1992. It offers a surface area of ​​57 m2, which is organized in a living room with a kitchen, bedroom, corridor, toilet and balcony. The apartment has been completely restored, new hydraulic and electrical system, new sanitary ware, new flooring, new doors and windows. Floored with parquet. The orientation of the apartment is South-East-West, which gives natural light. It is located in an area preferred by both locals and foreigners with all the services nearby, which makes it favorable both for residence and investment. There is quick access to the Tirana-Elbasan highway, the area of ​​Paris Municipality, Bajram Curri Boulevard, Kavaje Street. The property has regular ownership certificates. The price is 118,000 euros.
